text: Hi there! Here is your weather report for Tuesday, October 6. It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be bright as anything. The warmest part of the day will be 22 degrees, and the coolest 13. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. Rain is very unlikely today. There are 12 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Sunny days are good for the park. Don't forget your sun hat. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be sunny from start to finish, reaching 25 degrees. Still thinking about teachers this week. Has anything surprised you? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
